summary: Frontend-only testing of new features: Laporan Harian (Daily Report), Backup Data (Export/Import), and Receipt Share/Print. All 6 review checkpoints pass. Login admin/admin123 lands on Dashboard with the new blue theme (#205396 primary, #ef8d28 accent). More -> 'Laporan Harian' and 'Backup Data' are visible for admin and open their respective screens. Daily Report empty-state renders on today when no sales; report-prev-day switches to 'Kemarin'; report-next-day is disabled on today (aria-disabled=true). After creating a product (KS001 Kopi Susu @ Rp10.000, stok 50) and completing a cash sale, Laporan Harian for Hari ini shows Total Penjualan Rp10.000, Transaksi 1, Item Terjual 1, Terbayar Rp10.000, Piutang Rp0, report-method-cash row 'Tunai 1 transaksi Rp10.000', and report-top-0 '1 Kopi Susu 1 terjual Rp10.000' - all correct. Backup screen opens, 'Ekspor Data' triggers a JSON download named kasir-pos-backup-2026-10-03.json, and 'Pilih File Backup' opens the native file picker without crashing. Receipt screen renders receipt-share and receipt-print; tapping share shows the info toast 'Bagikan gambar tersedia di aplikasi HP' and tapping print calls window.print on web - neither crashes. One minor UI testID bug (Card not forwarding testID -> report-total was invisible to selectors) was found and fixed in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/card.tsx by adding a testID prop; verified fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: Card component did not forward testID prop; report-total on Daily Report hero card was not reachable by selector. Fixed by adding testID?: string prop and passing it to inner View. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/card.tsx

issues: Non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Carry over from iteration_1 - no functional impact.

action_items: No functional fixes required for the review checkpoints - all pass.
(Already applied by test agent) Card now forwards testID. Keep this change; it fixes report-total selector reachability and lets future testIDs on Card wrappers work.
(Pre-existing minor) Clean up RN-web 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: daily-report.tsx, backup.tsx, receipt.tsx cleanly use StyleSheet (makeStyles), wrap all text in <Text>, use testIDs on interactive elements, and read env/theme properly.

backup.tsx: good platform split - web uses Blob+anchor download, native uses expo-file-system/legacy + expo-sharing; expo-document-picker handles the picker. isValidBackup guard prevents junk imports. Could also offer a 'Simpan backup dulu' quick-link on the ConfirmSheet.
receipt.tsx: expo-print on web will invoke window.print via printAsync. Share correctly guarded on Platform.OS === 'web' with info toast - matches the requirement 'should not crash on web'.
more.tsx: role-gated menu items (isAdmin) correctly hide Laporan Harian, Pengguna, Backup Data for non-admins.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checkpoints (6/6) pass after minor Card testID fix

seed_data_creation: In-memory sql.js: default admin seeded on load. For data flow test, created product KS001 'Kopi Susu' Rp10.000 stok 50 and completed one cash sale (Rp10.000) within the same session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: sql.js is in-memory on web preview - page.goto() between steps RESETS the DB. Keep the whole flow in a single Playwright run and navigate via the bottom tab bar ('Produk', 'Kasir', 'Lainnya' - use .last to disambiguate from quick-action labels on the dashboard). Products are added to POS via pos-search -> pos-add-{SKU}, NOT via product cards. Pay sheet uses testIDs pay-amount + pay-confirm (sometimes outside the viewport on small screens - scrollIntoView before clicking or fall back to el.click() via page.evaluate). Receipt screen hides the tab bar; tap receipt-done to return to tabs. More menu testIDs follow the pattern more-{Label} (e.g., more-Laporan Harian, more-Backup Data). Card component now forwards testID after this iteration's fix.
rca_of_issue: report-total was 'missing' because Card did not forward the testID prop to its inner View. The visual card rendered fine; only the testID attribute was absent. Fixed by extending Props with testID?: string and spreading it onto <View>. Verified by re-running the flow: 'report-total NOW VISIBLE => Total Penjualan | Rp10.000'.
